unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U14: Identify dissolution routes and distinguish reconstitution

payload.title: Identify what ends and under which route
payload.core_explanation_md:
Dissolution of the firm ends the partnership relationship among all the partners; a change in constitution need not do so. The source distinguishes agreement, compulsory dissolution, contingent events, the at-will notice route and court-ordered dissolution. Expiry of a term, completion of an undertaking, death and insolvency must be read with the applicable contract qualifications.

Court grounds include the described incapacity, misconduct, persistent breach, transfer, continuing-loss and just-and-equitable situations. A lender should record the actual event, agreement and order rather than assume every partner departure ends the firm or that every continuing signature proves the old authority remains unchanged. A multi-business unlawfulness case also requires the statutory qualification instead of a blanket conclusion about all activities.

self_check.prompt_text: Does every partner change necessarily dissolve the firm?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Distinguish reconstitution from ending all partnership relations.

payload.stem_md: One partner retires and the remaining partners validly continue the firm under the agreement. Which distinction matters?

options.text_md: Reconstitution need not be dissolution of the firm
options.explanation_md: A change among partners differs from ending the whole relationship.

options.text_md: Any departure necessarily destroys all firm contracts
options.explanation_md: The stipulated continuation distinguishes a change in constitution from dissolution of the whole firm.

options.text_md: Continuation proves no legal event occurred
The bank can ignore the partnership agreement
options.explanation_md: It is relevant to continuity and authority.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A change among partners differs from ending the whole relationship.

payload.stem_md: The agreement has a continuation clause, but a file treats a partner death as automatically ending the firm without reading it. What was omitted?

options.text_md: A rule that death is never relevant
options.explanation_md: Death is relevant subject to applicable provisions.

options.text_md: The contractual qualification to the contingent-event dissolution rule
options.explanation_md: The agreement and law must be read together.
Branch preference does not settle continuation.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The agreement and law must be read together.
